title: Cave Drone
tagline: The starter game every new Glyphite game is copied from
description: Fly a small drone through a dark cave, blast the rock and catch the glowing gems that fly out. Small on purpose: it shows each engine feature once (materials, world generation, a rigid body drawn from a sprite, lights without a sun, projectiles and explosions, custom particles, HUD, tunables).
controls: fire a bolt (aim with the mouse)

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Downward pull on everything that falls.

thrust.label: Thrust
thrust.help: Drone lift at full power, as a multiple of gravity (at zero gravity: of 3 m/s²).

blastRadius.label: Blast radius
blastRadius.help: How much rock a bolt carves out.

gemsToWin.label: Gems to collect
gemsToWin.help: Gems needed to clear a cave.
